leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a basic job queue using an array to manage background tasks
Implement job processing logic that executes tasks asynchronously
Configure retry mechanisms with exponential backoff for failed jobs
Initialize job status tracking to monitor execution progress
Integrate error handling to manage job failures gracefully
Manipulate queue operations to add, process, and remove jobs
Apply job prioritization to control execution order
lessonTitle: Build background job queue with retries
